verdict.line: You lose if you trade into his Q-E poke at levels 3-5 without a shield up; you win if you survive to 6 and isolate him with R before his ult matters.

brief.thesis: Aatrox's Q (The Darkin Blade) threatens three separate swings at 675+ effective range and his E (Umbral Dash) both heals him on champion damage and lets him disengage, so he dictates early trades while Mordekaiser has no way to punish a dash. The equalizer is Mordekaiser's R (Realm of Death): once it's up at 6, pulling Aatrox into the void removes his dash as an escape and turns the fight into a stat-stripped 1v1 Mordekaiser's kit is built to win.

theirWindow.when: his E is up and Q is ready
theirWindow.what: He can poke with Q's first swing then dash away with E before you can punish, healing off Umbral Dash and Deathbringer Stance autos in the process. Don't chase a single Q into an E that's available — you just eat more poke for free.

yourWindow.when: his E (Umbral Dash) is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: This is when Death's Grasp (E) actually sticks, since he has no dash to cut the pull short. Land E into Q, consume Indestructible's shield if you took damage getting there, and commit.

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: Highest-performing start at 49.9% over 2839 games — the mana and sustain let you keep answering his poke with Q/W instead of running out of resources by level 4.

boots.why: Best-performing boots at 50% over 2913 games; flat physical reduction directly cuts his Q swings and Deathbringer Stance-empowered autos.

core.why: First item in the 56.9%-win-rate core path; the slow helps your E/Q actually land on a champion with a dash.
Second item in that same 56.9% path; omnivamp lets you out-sustain his Deathbringer Stance/Umbral Dash healing in extended trades.
Closes out the 56.9%-over-109-games core and punishes his auto-attack-reliant passive directly.

runes.keystoneWhy: You're forced into extended trades by his sustain, and Conqueror's adaptive force scales those trades in your favor the longer the fight runs — matching Mordekaiser's plan of outlasting rather than one-shotting.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 85.6% of games for a reason — Ignite's burn cuts directly into Deathbringer Stance and Umbral Dash healing, denying the sustain that gives Aatrox the lane edge.

playing.title: Play passive levels 3-5
playing.detail: His Q (The Darkin Blade) threatens up to three swings and his E heals him on champion damage — you have no way to punish the dash yet, so don't walk up for free trades.

playing.title: Only commit E when his dash is down
playing.detail: Death's Grasp only sticks if he can't Umbral Dash out of it. Check his E cooldown before pulling.

playing.title: Shield before you trade
playing.detail: Pop Indestructible (W) going into a trade so the damage you absorb becomes a shield you can consume to heal, directly countering his sustain race.

playing.title: Isolate him with R at 6
playing.detail: His ultimate is weak unranked at this stage — drag him into Realm of Death immediately on hitting level 6 and fight him alone before he can scale World Ender.

playing.title: Never chase past a live E
playing.detail: If his E is up, he dashes through or past you to reset the trade. Walk away instead of extending.

playing.title: Pull for multiple targets late
playing.detail: Death's Grasp pulls all enemies in its area, not just Aatrox — in skirmishes position it to catch his backline, not just him, since your scaling comes from multi-target Q/E.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and all win rates above come from measured OP.GG games on the current patch; the tells, timing windows, and trade reasoning are my own read of the mechanics, not measured data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid Aatrox’s (Q)-(E) combo when fighting him. Purchase Bramble Vest to gain the upper hand when fighting him.
